New shared helper in `index.js`. Every mouth calls this â€” no more schema drift.
```javascript
async function seedVocab(studentId, word, meaning_vi, source, env, grade = null) {
  word = (word || "").trim();
  if (!word) return { ok: false };
  const [listRaw, srsRaw] = await Promise.all([
    env.NET_PET_KV.get(`vocab_list_${studentId}`),
    env.NET_PET_KV.get(`srs_data_${studentId}`)
  ]);
  const list = listRaw ? JSON.parse(listRaw) : [];
  const srsMap = srsRaw ? JSON.parse(srsRaw) : {};
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!srsMap[word]) {
    srsMap[word] = { word, translation: meaning_vi || "", interval: 0, repetitions: 0,
                     ease_factor: 2.5, next_review: 0, last_grade: null,
                     source, first_seen: now, times_seen: 1 };
    if (grade != null) srsMap[word] = { ...srsMap[word], ...computeNextReview(srsMap[word], grade), word };
  } else {
    srsMap[word].times_seen = (srsMap[word].times_seen || 1) + 1;
    if (meaning_vi && !srsMap[word].translation) srsMap[word].translation = meaning_vi;
    if (grade != null) srsMap[word] = { ...srsMap[word], ...computeNextReview(srsMap[word], grade), word };
  }
  if (!list.find(w => w.word === word)) list.push({ word, meaning_vi: meaning_vi || "", source, ts: now });
  await Promise.all([
    env.NET_PET_KV.put(`vocab_list_${studentId}`, JSON.stringify(list.slice(-500))),
    env.NET_PET_KV.put(`srs_data_${studentId}`, JSON.stringify(srsMap))
  ]);
  return { ok: true, word, next_review: srsMap[word].next_review, source };
}
```

async function handleVocabDue(studentId, env) {
  if (!studentId || studentId.startsWith('sov100-test-')) return json({ due: [], count: 0 });
  const idCheck = validateStudentId(studentId);
  if (!idCheck.valid) return json({ error: idCheck.error }, 400);

      env.NET_PET_KV.get(`srs_data_${studentId}`),
      env.NET_PET_KV.get(`vocab_list_${studentId}`)

    const now = Date.now();

      .map(w => ({ word: w.word, translation: w.translation || meanings[w.word] || "", source: w.source }));
    return json({ due, count: due.length });
  } catch (err) {

}

File: [chat.js:1929-1932](APPS/NET-PET-AI/public/chat.js#L1929-L1932)
Root cause: `confirmLandingMode()` calls `window.history.replaceState()` inserting `?mode=X` into the URL. On the next page load/refresh, `urlMode` is non-null â†’ `if (urlMode)` branch runs at line 2009 â†’ landing is hidden without user interaction. The `landingSeen` check we removed is now being re-created by the URL state we inject. The original bug returns one session later.
Fix: Remove `url.searchParams.set('mode', currentMode)` from `confirmLandingMode()`. Mode should be stored only in `localStorage`, never injected into the URL as persistent state.

**EC-15: visibilitychange listener leak (confirmed code read)**
File: [chat.js:1143-1152](APPS/NET-PET-AI/public/chat.js#L1143-L1152)
Root cause: `keepAliveHandler` is defined as a new closure inside the `SettingsApplied` block. `document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", keepAliveHandler)` is called at line 1152 but the reference is never stored. `onAgentDrop` at line 1010-1038 cannot call `removeEventListener(keepAliveHandler)` â€” it's a different closure. Every reconnect (SettingsApplied fires again) adds one more permanent listener. After 5 reconnects = 5 handlers all firing simultaneously on tab focus.
Fix: Move `keepAliveHandler` definition to module scope and store the reference so `onAgentDrop` can call `document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", keepAliveHandler)`.

**EC-21: CLIENT_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT during long OBI responses**
File: [chat.js:1135-1141](APPS/NET-PET-AI/public/chat.js#L1135-L1141)
Root cause: KeepAlive interval sends `{ type: "KeepAlive" }` JSON only. Deepgram Voice Agent keeps the audio stream alive via binary PCM16 frames. When `agentPlaying=true` (OBI speaking), the mic sends no audio â†’ no binary frames â†’ after ~10s Deepgram sends `CLIENT_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT` and drops. Grammar explanations, study summaries are all >10s.
Fix: During `agentPlaying`, send a 160-byte zero-filled `Int16Array` alongside the JSON KeepAlive.

**EC-22: Silence nudge inject has no watchdog**
File: [chat.js:1465-1471](APPS/NET-PET-AI/public/chat.js#L1465-L1471)
Root cause: `agentWs.send(JSON.stringify({ type: "InjectAgentMessage", ... }))` fire-and-forget. Deepgram GitHub #463 confirms InjectAgentMessage can be silently dropped. `agentSilenceFired = true` is set before the send at line 1466, so if the inject is dropped OBI never speaks and the flag prevents any retry. Student sits in silence for the rest of the session.
Fix: Set a 5s watchdog after inject. If no `ConversationText` with `source="inject"` received, fire `obi("Take your time...")` as local fallback text bubble.
